scope: Read-only dependency inventory; environment values excluded; selected source bytes preserved privately, not imported into Core.

copy_instructions: COPY model.py app.py assets.yaml facility-guide.yaml entrypoint.sh ./

boundary_findings.finding: Changes bridge sysctl, persists it in sysctl.conf, flushes DOCKER-USER, inserts raw PREROUTING rules. Do not import as host initialization.
DNAT preserves source for web; mail/bastion API forwarding and Wazuh registration are coupled to baseline startup.
Suricata uses -i capture, not NFQUEUE; includes GPU/OT routes, Wazuh registration, shell audit and embedded console.
Requires seven target services; all vhosts are enabled; target removal must also remove routes, ports and landing links.
